premise: Office lo Krishna Leelalu follows Prasad, an incorrigible flirt who juggles various romantic interests while pursuing Vaishu, who claims to have philophobia.

nicknames.name: Vaishu
nicknames.note: Prasad teasingly calls Vaishu Bhramara (illusion) throughout their encounters

nicknames.name: Pratheeksha
nicknames.note: Interchangeably addressed as Pratheeksha or Pratyusha

running_bits: Prasad twisting the term 'philophobia' into a literal fatal illness or mental weakness
Prasad asking women for money / loans whenever rejected
Prasad getting called 'అన్నయ్య' (brother) and reacting dramatically
catchphrases: రెండు వందలు ఇవ్వు English లో మాట్లాడతాను
relationships: Prasad and Vaishu: Main romantic tension, Prasad constantly pesters her while she resists before falling for him
Prasad and Pooja: Family relatives / friends who bicker constantly; elders want them married
Prasad and Pratheeksha: Colleague and manager whom Prasad attempts to woo before she discovers his flirtatious past
